extra_vocab.en: a thing that cools the air in a room, or makes hair soft
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見的是 air conditioner（冷氣機），辦公室、飯店與維修情境都會出現；在飯店備品中，conditioner 也可指潤髮乳。

example.en: The hotel replaced all the old conditioners in the guest rooms.
example.zh: 飯店換掉了客房裡所有舊的冷氣機。

example.en: The air conditioner in the meeting room is broken.
example.zh: 會議室的冷氣機壞了。

example.en: The hotel gives guests free shampoo and hair conditioner.
example.zh: 飯店免費提供房客洗髮精和潤髮乳。

examples.en: Please turn off the air conditioner before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請關掉冷氣。

examples.en: The bathroom has shampoo, conditioner, and soap for guests.
examples.zh: 浴室備有洗髮精、潤髮乳和肥皂供房客使用。

examples.en: A technician will repair the conditioner this afternoon.
examples.zh: 技術人員今天下午會修理這台冷氣機。

confusable.diff: condition 是「狀況、條件」；conditioner 是「調節的東西」。

example.en: The machine is in good condition after the repair.
example.zh: 這台機器修理後狀況良好。

similar.diff: air conditioning 指整個「空調系統」，不可數；air conditioner 指「冷氣機」這台設備。

example.en: The new office has air conditioning on every floor.
example.zh: 新辦公室每一層樓都有空調。

example.en: Please turn on the heater in the waiting room.
example.zh: 請打開等候室的暖氣。

example.en: We use a fan because the air conditioner is broken.
example.zh: 冷氣壞了，所以我們用電風扇。

example.en: The hotel sells shampoo and soap at the front desk.
example.zh: 飯店在櫃檯販售洗髮精和肥皂。

derived.link: condition 是詞幹；conditioner = condition + -er，改善狀況的東西，像 teacher、printer
condition + -ing，變成名詞，air conditioning 就是「空調」
condition + -al，形容詞，有附帶條件的，像 national、additional

senses.zh: 冷氣機（air conditioner 的簡稱）
senses.en: a machine that makes the air in a room cool
senses.distinguish: 和 room、office、broken、repair 一起出現時，指冷氣機。

example.en: The conditioner makes too much noise in the conference room.
example.zh: 會議室的冷氣機噪音太大。

senses.en: a product you put on your hair after washing it
senses.distinguish: 和 shampoo、hotel、bathroom 一起出現時，指潤髮乳。

example.en: Please buy shampoo and conditioner for the staff trip.
example.zh: 請為員工旅遊買洗髮精和潤髮乳。

extra_vocab.en: a good wish you give when someone has done something well
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於升遷、得獎、簽約等恭賀的電子郵件與卡片。向人道賀時一定用複數 Congratulations，單數 congratulation 多用在 words of congratulation 之類的說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 說「恭喜」要用複數 Congratulations!，後面接 on + 名詞或 V-ing（Congratulations on your promotion），介系詞用 on，不用 for。

example.en: Congratulations on your promotion to sales director, Ms. Chen!
example.zh: 恭喜陳小姐升任業務總監！

example.en: Please send our congratulations to the winning team.
example.zh: 請向獲勝的團隊轉達我們的祝賀。

example.en: He wrote a few words of congratulation on the card.
example.zh: 他在卡片上寫了幾句祝賀的話。

example.en: I would like to offer congratulations to everyone on the project team.
example.zh: 我想向專案團隊的每個人致上祝賀。

examples.en: Congratulations! You have been selected as employee of the month.
examples.zh: 恭喜！你被選為本月最佳員工。

examples.en: We held a small party as a sign of congratulation.
examples.zh: 我們辦了一場小派對表示祝賀。

examples.en: The manager opened the meeting with a word of congratulation.
examples.zh: 經理在會議開頭先說了一句祝賀的話。

confusable.diff: congratulation 是名詞（祝賀）；congratulate 是動詞（向…道賀）。
confusable.usage: 動詞用法是 congratulate + 人 + on + 事；名詞用法是 Congratulations on + 事。

example.en: We congratulate Ms. Lin on her new position.
example.zh: 我們向林小姐的新職位道賀。

similar.diff: best wishes 是祝福未來；congratulations 是為已完成的好事道賀。

example.en: Best wishes for your new job in Chicago.
example.zh: 祝你在芝加哥的新工作順利。

similar.diff: well done 是口語的稱讚「做得好」；congratulations 較正式。

example.en: Well done, everyone, we reached the sales goal.
example.zh: 大家做得好，我們達成了業績目標。

example.en: We will celebrate the new contract with a team dinner.
example.zh: 我們會用團隊晚餐慶祝新合約。

example.en: The client praised our fast and careful work.
example.zh: 客戶稱讚我們快速又細心的工作。

example.en: She received an award for her excellent service.
example.zh: 她因優良的服務獲得獎項。

derived.link: congratulate 是詞幹動詞；加 -ion 變名詞，像 educate → education
congratulate + -ory，形容詞，如 congratulatory message（祝賀訊息）

extra_vocab.en: to tell someone you are happy about their success
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於升遷、完成專案、得獎時的電子郵件與致詞，語氣正式又客氣。常見句型是 congratulate + 人 + on + 事。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: congratulate 後面接「人」，再用 on 接事情：congratulate Tom on his promotion；不要說 congratulate his promotion。被動是 be congratulated on。

example.en: The president congratulates every new employee on the first day.
example.zh: 總裁在第一天向每位新進員工道賀。

example.en: The CEO congratulated the staff on reaching the sales goal.
example.zh: 執行長祝賀員工達成業績目標。

example.en: She is congratulating her coworker on winning the sales award.
example.zh: 她正在恭喜同事獲得銷售獎。

example.en: I called to congratulate Mr. Kim on his new job.
example.zh: 我打電話向金先生的新工作道賀。

example.en: I would like to congratulate the whole sales team on a great year.
example.zh: 我想為整個業務團隊的出色一年道賀。

example.en: We can congratulate ourselves on finishing the project early.
example.zh: 我們可以為提早完成專案而自我慶賀。

examples.en: I am writing to congratulate you on your promotion.
examples.zh: 我寫信是想恭喜你升遷。

examples.en: Let's congratulate Anna on winning the company award today.
examples.zh: 讓我們一起恭喜安娜今天獲得公司獎項。

examples.en: We congratulate your company on its tenth anniversary.
examples.zh: 我們恭賀貴公司創立十週年。

confusable.diff: 拼法接近，但 congregate 是「聚集」。

example.en: Employees congregate in the lobby before the morning meeting.
example.zh: 員工在晨會前聚集在大廳。

similar.diff: praise 是稱讚人的表現；congratulate 是為好事或成就道賀。

example.en: The manager praised the team for its fast work.
example.zh: 經理稱讚團隊的工作速度很快。

similar.diff: applaud 是拍手稱許，語氣較有動作感；congratulate 多用話語或信件表達。

example.en: Everyone applauded when the winner walked onto the stage.
example.zh: 得獎者走上舞台時，大家鼓掌。

example.en: Let's celebrate the product launch with a small party.
example.zh: 讓我們用一場小派對慶祝新產品上市。

example.en: Customers often praise our friendly service.
example.zh: 顧客常稱讚我們親切的服務。

example.en: I want to thank everyone for coming to the event.
example.zh: 我要感謝每個人來參加這場活動。

derived.link: congratulate + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 educate → education；常用複數 Congratulations!
congratulate + -ory，形容詞，如 a congratulatory email（祝賀信）

extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於報告與電子郵件，說明數字、價格或時間「有明顯的變化或差距」，語氣比 very much 正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: considerably 常修飾比較級或表示變化的動詞（considerably cheaper、improve considerably），不用來修飾原級形容詞，不說 considerably cheap。

example.en: Sales are considerably higher than we expected this month.
example.zh: 這個月的銷售額比我們預期的高出許多。

example.en: Our delivery time has improved considerably this year.
example.zh: 我們今年的交貨時間大幅縮短。

example.en: Hotel prices vary considerably between the two cities.
example.zh: 這兩個城市的飯店價格差異很大。

examples.en: The company's profits grew considerably in the last quarter.
examples.zh: 公司的利潤在上一季大幅成長。

examples.en: This model is considerably cheaper than the old one.
examples.zh: 這個型號比舊款便宜許多。

examples.en: The new system reduced our work time considerably.
examples.zh: 新系統大幅減少了我們的工作時間。

confusable.diff: considerable 是形容詞，意思是「相當大的」；considerably 是副詞。
confusable.usage: considerable 修飾名詞（a considerable amount）；considerably 修飾動詞或比較級。

example.en: We spent a considerable amount of money on advertising.
example.zh: 我們花了相當多的錢在廣告上。

similar.diff: significantly 強調「差異重要、明顯」；considerably 強調「幅度大」。

example.en: Costs dropped significantly after we changed suppliers.
example.zh: 換了供應商之後，成本明顯下降。

similar.diff: greatly 多修飾動詞（greatly appreciate）；considerably 也常修飾比較級。

example.en: We greatly appreciate your quick reply to our request.
example.zh: 我們非常感謝你很快回覆我們的請求。

example.en: Your help greatly improved our work schedule.
example.zh: 你的幫忙大大改善了我們的工作時程。

example.en: Prices rose slightly in the second half of the year.
example.zh: 下半年價格稍微上漲。

example.en: The report was quite long, but it was useful.
example.zh: 這份報告相當長，但很有用。

derived.link: consider 是詞幹，「仔細想」的意思
consider + -able，值得考慮的，所以「份量不小」；considerably 就是再加 -ly
consider + -ate，會為別人著想的，像 fortunate

extra_vocab.en: a machine that makes copies of papers
extra_vocab.note: 多益辦公室情境的高頻字，常出現在影印機卡紙（paper jam）、缺碳粉、報修與採購的對話中。

example.en: Both copiers on the third floor need new toner today.
example.zh: 三樓的兩台影印機今天都需要換新碳粉。

example.en: You can use the copier after you enter your code.
example.zh: 輸入代碼後就可以使用影印機。

example.en: There is a paper jam in the copier again.
example.zh: 影印機又卡紙了。

example.en: Copier repair usually takes about two working days.
example.zh: 影印機維修通常需要大約兩個工作天。

examples.en: The copier is on the second floor next to the kitchen.
examples.zh: 影印機在二樓廚房旁邊。

examples.en: The copier stopped working because paper was stuck inside.
examples.zh: 影印機因為裡面卡了紙而停止運作。

examples.en: We plan to buy a new copier for the sales office.
examples.zh: 我們打算為業務辦公室買一台新影印機。

confusable.diff: copy 是「影本」或「影印」這個動作；copier 是做影印的「機器」。

example.en: Please make ten copies of the agenda for the meeting.
example.zh: 請為會議影印十份議程。

similar.diff: photocopier 和 copier 意思一樣，只是說法較完整、較正式。

example.en: The photocopier needs more toner before the big meeting.
example.zh: 大型會議前，影印機需要補充碳粉。

similar.diff: printer 是從電腦印出文件；copier 是直接複印紙本。

example.en: Please send the file to the printer on the first floor.
example.zh: 請把檔案傳到一樓的印表機。

example.en: The printer is out of paper again.
example.zh: 印表機又沒紙了。

example.en: Use the scanner to send the contract by email.
example.zh: 請用掃描機把合約用電子郵件寄出。

example.en: We ordered new toner for the office copier.
example.zh: 我們為辦公室影印機訂了新碳粉。

derived.link: copy 是詞幹；copier = copy + -er，做影印的機器，像 printer、teacher

extra_vocab.en: to change something to fit what a person needs
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於產品、軟體、服務與網頁設定，意思是「依客戶需求調整」，常用被動 be customized to fit…。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: customize 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞（customize a product）；英式拼法是 customise。

example.en: Our designer customizes every order for the client's brand.
example.zh: 我們的設計師會依客戶品牌客製每一張訂單。

example.en: We customized the report to match the client's needs.
example.zh: 我們依客戶需求客製了這份報告。

example.en: The company offers customized training for new employees.
example.zh: 這家公司為新進員工提供客製化訓練。

example.en: Our team is customizing the software for a new client.
example.zh: 我們的團隊正在為新客戶客製軟體。

example.en: We can customize a product to fit your needs.
example.zh: 我們可以依你的需求客製產品。

example.en: You can customize the settings on your account page.
example.zh: 你可以在帳戶頁面自訂設定。

example.en: Customers can customize an order with their own logo.
example.zh: 顧客可以用自己的標誌客製訂單。

examples.en: Our team can customize the software for each client.
examples.zh: 我們的團隊可以為每位客戶客製軟體。

examples.en: Users can customize their home page with different colors.
examples.zh: 使用者可以用不同顏色自訂首頁。

examples.en: We customize gift boxes with your company logo.
examples.zh: 我們會在禮盒上加上貴公司的標誌。

confusable.diff: 拼法接近；customs 是「海關」，和客製化無關。

example.en: Your goods will stay at customs until you pay the fee.
example.zh: 在你付費之前，貨物會留在海關。

similar.diff: personalize 偏向加上個人的名字或資料；customize 偏向依需求調整內容。

example.en: The system can personalize emails for every customer.
example.zh: 這個系統可以為每位顧客個人化電子郵件。

similar.diff: tailor to 語氣較正式，常寫成 tailor + N + to + 對象。

example.en: We tailor our services to each customer's needs.
example.zh: 我們依每位顧客的需求調整服務。

example.en: Please adjust the chair to a comfortable height.
example.zh: 請把椅子調整到舒適的高度。

example.en: We need to modify the design before we print it.
example.zh: 印刷前我們需要修改設計。

derived.link: custom 是詞幹，原意是「習慣的做法」，例如 custom-made（訂做的）
custom + -er，常來買東西的人，像 teacher、worker
customize + -ation，動詞變名詞，像 organize → organization

extra_vocab.zh: 乘船遊覽、郵輪旅行；（船、飛機）平穩航行
extra_vocab.en: a trip on a big ship for fun
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於旅遊與公司活動情境，如 a cruise ship、take a cruise、book a cruise。當動詞時可指乘船遊覽，也可指飛機、船以穩定速度前進。

example.en: The travel agency sells several cruises to Alaska each summer.
example.zh: 這家旅行社每年夏天都販售多條前往阿拉斯加的郵輪行程。

example.en: The ship cruised slowly past the harbor at night.
example.zh: 那艘船夜裡緩緩駛過港口。

example.en: The plane is cruising at a steady speed now.
example.zh: 飛機現在正以穩定的速度飛行。

example.en: The cruise ship leaves the port at six p.m.
example.zh: 這艘郵輪晚上六點離開港口。

example.en: We plan to take a cruise after the annual meeting.
example.zh: 我們打算在年會後搭郵輪旅行。

example.en: The cruise line offers a discount for early booking.
example.zh: 這家郵輪公司提供提早預訂的優惠。

examples.en: The tour includes a three-day cruise along the coast.
examples.zh: 這個行程包含沿著海岸的三天郵輪旅行。

examples.en: Please book your cruise at least one month early.
examples.zh: 請至少提早一個月預訂你的郵輪行程。

examples.en: The plane cruises at an altitude of ten thousand meters.
examples.zh: 這架飛機以一萬公尺的高度平穩飛行。

confusable.diff: 發音完全相同；crews 是 crew（工作人員、組員）的複數。

example.en: Two crews will clean the cabins before guests arrive.
example.zh: 客人抵達前，會有兩組人員打掃船艙。

similar.diff: voyage 指較長的海上或太空航程；cruise 偏向休閒遊覽的行程。

example.en: The voyage across the ocean took ten days.
example.zh: 橫越大洋的航程花了十天。

example.en: The ship will arrive at the port on Monday.
example.zh: 這艘船將在星期一抵達港口。

example.en: Every passenger must show a ticket at the gate.
example.zh: 每位乘客都必須在登船口出示船票。

example.en: The hotel offers a free city tour every morning.
example.zh: 飯店每天早上提供免費的市區導覽。

example.en: The company gave the top sellers a free cruise.
example.zh: 公司送給業績最好的銷售員一趟免費郵輪旅行。

example.en: Our ship will cruise along the coast for three days.
example.zh: 我們的船將沿著海岸航行三天。

extra_vocab.en: letters or emails that people send and receive
extra_vocab.note: 多益商務書信與電子郵件的重點字，指一來一往的信件或郵件，是不可數名詞。常見於 business correspondence、correspondence with a client。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示信件時 correspondence 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 a correspondence；要算數量可說 a piece of correspondence。

example.en: Good business correspondence should be short and clear.
example.zh: 好的商務信件應該簡短又清楚。

example.en: Please keep all correspondence with the client in one folder.
example.zh: 請把和客戶的所有往來信件放在同一個資料夾。

example.en: The assistant handles all correspondence for the director.
example.zh: 助理負責處理主管所有的信件。

example.en: All email correspondence is saved in our shared drive.
example.zh: 所有電子郵件往來都存在我們的共用雲端硬碟。

examples.en: Please file all correspondence from last month in the cabinet.
examples.zh: 請把上個月所有的信件歸檔到櫃子裡。

examples.en: We will reply to your correspondence within three working days.
examples.zh: 我們會在三個工作天內回覆你的來信。

examples.en: In your correspondence, please mention the job number.
examples.zh: 在你的信件中，請註明職缺編號。

confusable.diff: correspondent 指「人」（通訊員、特派記者）；correspondence 指「信件往來」。

example.en: A foreign correspondent wrote about our new factory.
example.zh: 一位外國特派記者報導了我們的新工廠。

similar.diff: communication 範圍更廣，包含電話、會議與口頭溝通；correspondence 專指書信、郵件往來。

example.en: We need clear communication between the two offices.
example.zh: 我們需要兩個辦公室之間清楚的溝通。

example.en: The letter arrived at our office this morning.
example.zh: 這封信今天早上寄到我們辦公室。

example.en: The mail is delivered to the front desk at ten.
example.zh: 郵件在十點送到櫃檯。

example.en: Please leave a message after you hear the tone.
example.zh: 聽到提示音後請留言。

derived.link: correspond 是詞幹動詞；correspondence = correspond + -ence，變名詞，像 differ → difference
correspond + -ing，形容詞，如 the corresponding page（對應的頁面）

senses.en: letters or emails that people send and receive
senses.distinguish: 和 client、email、file、reply 一起出現時，指信件往來。

example.en: I will answer your correspondence by the end of the week.
example.zh: 我會在本週結束前回覆你的來信。

senses.en: a close match or link between two things
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 between 或 with，講兩件事物是否一致時，指相符。

example.en: There is no correspondence between the two sets of numbers.
example.zh: 這兩組數字之間並不相符。
